properties.name: analysis.scope
properties.value: static PE strings, imports, Go build metadata, pclntab function symbols, and resolved direct/indirect call sites

properties.name: analysis.warning
properties.value: String matches and linked symbols do not prove runtime execution.

properties.name: analysis.limitations
properties.value: A string hit shows that text is present in the binary; it does not prove the algorithm is used.; An imported crypto API indicates a dependency or capability, not the exact algorithm selected at runtime.; Names hidden by packing, encryption, dynamic construction, or constants are not detected by this string catalog.; The catalog includes common classical, post-quantum, hybrid, and MAC variants, but is not exhaustive; absence of a hit is not evidence that the binary has no cryptography.; Short names such as DSA and LMS can be ambiguous in strings; review each matched string and its address before treating it as an algorithm implementation.; Indirect edges are reported only when existing disassembly/data-flow analysis yields concrete candidate targets.; Go interface dispatch and function values are not inferred from type metadata; unresolved calls remain explicit.; Inlining, callbacks whose targets are not call targets, and unresolved thunks are not included.; Reachability from recovered Go main/init roots is static and is not runtime observation.
